summary: The peer-to-peer file-sharing service Shawn Fanning and Sean Parker launched from a dorm room. Millions swapped MP3s through it until record companies and artists sued it out of existence, and it changed the music business for good.

events.note: Launches as a free music file-sharing app.

events.label: Metallica sues
events.note: Metallica files a copyright lawsuit, followed by others.
A court injunction forces Napster to shut down its network.
Napster files for bankruptcy in June 2002; Roxio buys the name, which lives on in unrelated music services.

cause: Shut down by court order over copyright.
